scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/forceFrontendVersion.cjs && npm run check:bundle
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:theme && npm run build
scripts.android:add: npm run android:prepare && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run android:prepare && npm run build:native && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:prepare && cap open android
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:prepare && npm run build:native && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab:release: npm run android:prepare && npm run build:native && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.ios:add: npm run ios:prepare && cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run ios:prepare && npm run build:native && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:prepare && cap open ios
